# Code Anchors: Config Write-Back

- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.ts` — the add-only merge itself: it adds absent keys only, never rewrites a declared value, never writes an empty one, targets the given root without walking to an ancestor, and creates the configuration directory and file when they are absent.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.spec.ts` — writer coverage: the freshly created block, the untouched declared key, the no-change report, the byte-identical survival of other sections and comments, and the given-root targeting.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts` — the command surface the attended producer drives, including the comment written above a freshly created block; its flag list is deliberately the bootstrap subset rather than the whole catalogue.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — the derived inverse this writer translates the resolver's names back through, so a key it can resolve is a key it can seed.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/create_epic.py`, `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/create_story.py` — the unattended producers on the two filing paths, persisting the classification and project they resolved on a first fallback run; frozen against the predecessor resolver until their own ports land.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/delivery_config.py` — the frozen predecessor those filers still write through for the interim.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — the attended producer: detects classification, lists candidate projects and asks when several match, falls back to safe values with a recorded reason when the tooling is unreachable, and reports the seeded block for review.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — surfaces the unattended seed in its completion report, so the uncommitted config change is reviewed and committed.
